## Stop here if this is a vulnerability

Do **not** submit sensitive vulnerability details in a public GitHub issue.

Use one of the private channels in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md):

- GitHub Security Advisory: <https://github.com/RyanMerlin/curio/security/advisories/new>
- Maintainer contact path described on the repository profile

## If this is not a vulnerability

If you are reporting a hardening improvement, documentation gap, or a false positive from a scanner with no active exploit path, close this draft and use a normal issue template instead.
